instruction: Candid full shot at eye-level inside an indoor martial arts gym with gray padded walls. On the right, the young man in the white t-shirt (R1) is seen from behind in a defensive stance with his arms raised. On the left, the man in the gray t-shirt (R2) lunges forward dynamically, throwing a punch toward his partner. Both wear protective gear and are fully engaged in the fast-paced sparring exchange. In the background, three bystanders stand against the walls watching the sparring. Overhead fluorescent lighting illuminates the gray mats, casting soft shadows.
